phase: Original EPG10-08 round2; producer implementation before Edge acceptance

transport.listener: Existing PM PortalHumanRecoveryServer, optional mapping source
transport.authentication: TLS1.3 mutual CA verification and exact current peer leaf pin, checked before HTTP metadata

request.request_id: Fresh canonical UUID; exact response correlation, not a permission or idempotency key
request.identity_component_bound: Each issuer/subject/workspace/workload is 1..512 UTF-8 bytes, exact trimmed text with no control characters
request.subject: Exact stable Portal subject, including an authorized target lookup; never display-name/email inference or target-session impersonation

response.binding: All six request binding fields must match exactly

found.revision: ts-user:<same canonical UUID>:<canonical positive source version, <=9223372036854775807, <=19 digits, never JS Number>

not_found.meaning: No exact existing active mapping; unknown and inactive are intentionally indistinguishable

response.grammar: Flat strict JSON objects only; duplicate keys, escaped aliases, invalid UTF-8, extra fields and nonfinite values rejected

source.authority: Existing TS ts_users unique issuer+subject, not a new identity store
source.query: Parameterized exact pair SELECT; read-only transaction; pinned database name/session login/current role and trusted pool target; explicit acquire, lock and statement bounds

consumer.installation: Mandatory finite max_inflight and independently accepted installation_expires_at_utc_ms; no default TTL or queue. Reject expired/busy before I/O, recheck expiry after I/O, release every owned slot on all terminal paths. These private configuration pins do not grant business authority.
consumer.unavailable_or_invalid: Fail closed without source body, URL or credential disclosure
consumer.other_authority_callbacks: Preserved; mapping cannot supply policy, membership, publication, command or field grants

decision_boundary: Fresh transport-authenticated preflight observation only. It does not hold source revocation across later Core/TS COMMIT; final receipt/business paths must retain their existing qualified source fence. A candidate issuer is a different identity and must not alias accepted TS users.

activation.required: Genuine independently accepted identity tuple/trust/current grants, qualified producer return and actual Edge revoke/cache/cursor/SSE measurements
